option_relations.rationale: The clinical presentation and histopathological findings are consistent with linear or annular lupus erythematosus panniculitis of the scalp (LALPS), which is a rare variant of lupus erythematosus.
Lupus erythematosus profundus is a subtype of lupus erythematosus that primarily affects the subcutaneous fat, but the clinical presentation in this case is more consistent with LALPS.

Discoid lupus erythematosus is a distinct entity that primarily affects the skin, but the clinical presentation and histopathological findings in this case are not consistent with discoid lupus erythematosus.
Lupus panniculitis (lupus profundus) is a subtype of lupus erythematosus that primarily affects the subcutaneous fat, but the clinical presentation in this case is more consistent with LALPS.
